a.lede: The president wants U.S. data center companies to stay within U.S. borders or pay a hefty fee if they want to build in foreign countries.
a.title: Trump wants to ban US companies from building overseas data centers as bans slow development

b.lede: President threatens 'tremendous tax' on overseas builds, but analysts question how restrictions would work
b.title: Trump says he won't allow US companies to build datacenters abroad
